testcase.name: Scenario: Insert a separator after a selected custom panel row: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-customization-source/features/application/ribbon-customization/ribbon-customization.feature:883:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Insert a separator after a selected custom panel row ✔> Given the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And a part is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the Ribbon customization dialog shows All Commands and an empty Part Tools target ✔ When the user double-clicks "2D Sketches" and then "3D Annotations" in the available list ✔ Then the custom panel list contains "2D Sketches" followed by "3D Annotations" ✔ When the user selects "2D Sketches" in the custom panel list ✔ And the user selects "<Separator>" in the available list ✔ And the user clicks the right transfer button ✔ Then the custom panel list contains these rows in order: | 2D Sketches | | <Separator> | | 3D Annotations | ✔ And "<Separator>" remains in the available list ✔ When the user clicks Cancel ✔ Then the customization dialog closes ✔ And no User Commands panel is visible on the Tools ribbon
